chapter.verse: Topa phat un! Bang hang hiam cih leh i Pasian tungah phatnate i sak ding hoih hi; phatna sak ding nuam a, zong kilawm hi.
Topa in Jerusalem khuapi lam a, amah in a kinilkhia Israelte kaikhawm hi.
Amah in lungsim kitamte damsak a, amau’ meimate tuamsak hi.
Amah in aksite a phazah ding seh a, tuate amau min ciatin a sam hi.
I Topa lian hi, ama vangliatna lian mahmah a, amah in thu a theihtelna pen ngaihsut zawh ding hi lo hi.
Topa in a kisikcip mite laamto-in, migilote leilak den’na hi.
Topa tungah lungdam kohna la sa un la, laiza lasakna tawh i Pasian tungah la ngaih sa un!
Amah in vanpite pen meiipite tawh tuamin, leitung adingin guah bawl a, mualte tungah lopa posak hi.
Amah in ganhingte leh a ham va-ak note an vak hi.
Ama lungkimna leh amah in nuam a sak nate pen sakol thahatna leh galhangte’ hang hi lo hi.
Topa in amah a zahtak mite leh ama itna kip a muangte tungah lungkim hi.
Jerusalem khuapi aw, Topa phat in. Zion aw, nangma Pasian phat in!
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in na kulh kongpi zawlte tosak a, na mite, thupha hong piaksak hi.
Amah in na gam sungah kilemna bawl a, mangbuh hoihpente tawh nang hong dimsak hi.
Amah in thu hong pia a, ama thu manlangin leitung hong tungsuk hi.
Amah in tuumul bangin vukkhal hong pia a, vut bangin vuukpaak hong thehthang hi.
Amah in suangtum bangin a tuikhalte hong lawnkhia hi; tua a votna kua in thuak zo ding ahi hiam?
Amah in thupia-in tuate tuisak hi; amah in a huih nungsak a, tuite a luang hi.
Amah in Jakob tungah ama thu gen a, Israel tungah ama ngeina kipte leh ama biakna ngeina kipte a gen hi.
Amah in tua bangin minam dang khatpeuh peuh tungah bawl lo hi; amaute in amau biakna ngeina kipte thei lo uh hi. Topa phat un!
